## Question

Does gray whale body length increase with age, and does it differ by sex?

## Data

Drone-based measurements of gray whales from the R package `Xcertainty` (Bierlich et al. 2024, <https://doi.org/10.1111/gcb.17366>). Body length was measured in pixels and converted to meters using the drone's altitude and camera settings. Images without a length or altitude were removed.

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
whales_clean <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "whales_clean.csv"))
```

After cleaning, the data contain `r nrow(whales_clean)` images of `r n_distinct(whales_clean$whale_id)` individual whales.

## Result

```{r}
#| label: fig-length-age
#| fig-cap: "Mean body length against age, per whale and year."
knitr::include_graphics(here("output", "figure_length_vs_age.png"))
```

## Reproducibility

This report was made with the scripts in the `scripts/` folder. See the README for how to run them.
